notes_for_editor: Thin record: the register entry, a one-line Klamath National Forest chronology entry quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, and general Aircraft Warning Service context from Wikipedia. No staffing, fire, or current-site information was found. The 'built' event is a temporary cabin, not a permanent lookout, and the register says the replacement question is unknown. Wikipedia was used only for service-wide dates (May 1941 organization, May 29, 1944 deactivation); it does not mention this peak. The chronology is cited as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the original Klamath National Forest history was not read. Possible follow-up: the Klamath National Forest history volume and the Siskiyou County Museum photo credited on the register. The lat/lon in the record matches the register.
